violations.requirement: The offset must stay in bounds of the same allocated object (at most one past the end).
violations.explanation: The safe pub fn takes an arbitrary `index` and calls `s.as_ptr().add(index)` without checking `index <= s.len()`. A large index gives an out-of-bounds pointer offset, which is UB.

violations.requirement: The index must be in bounds of the slice.
violations.explanation: The safe public trait method calls `get_unchecked(index)` with no bounds check. A caller can pass an out-of-range index.

violations.requirement: The index must be in bounds of the slice.

violations.requirement: The index must be in bounds of the slice.
violations.explanation: The safe pub fn calls `get_unchecked(index / L)` without checking that `index / L < len`. A caller can pass an out-of-range index.
